recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: new m6 silicon arriving in fourteen-inch machines
debate over whether software is decaying or just remembering the bad old days
python's experimental jit removed before most felt the speed
autumn night over san francisco, mostly clear at eleven degrees
shipping hour shrinking as daylight fades toward winter

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Catch falling compile tokens before they scatter into lint errors that clog the screen — a quiet-repo autumn where every miss leaves debris.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: chain ten clean catches to trigger a satisfying build-passed chime
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: tokens fall faster and split into semicolons that block lanes
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: terminal green on fog-gray autumn sky

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Tap commits onto a sunrise timeline before the golden hour window closes — ship by sunrise as a rhythm game against a shrinking daylight arc.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: tap pulsing nodes along a curved timeline
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: nail the final sunrise beat to trigger a deploy animation
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: beat windows shrink as the sun crests the horizon
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: watercolor dawn gradient over silhouette city

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Trace agent routes from a phone shortcut through a grid of GitHub Actions nodes without crossing wires — spin up agents from your thumb.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag to trace paths, lift finger to commit route
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: complete a three-agent pipeline in under forty-five seconds
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: new node types appear mid-round forcing reroutes through tighter gaps

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick M6 chip modules into matching MacBook slots before the assembly line accelerates — a one-screen sorting frenzy inspired by today's hardware drop.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: swipe to flick chips toward slots
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: slot a perfect row of four chips for a magnetic snap finish
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: wrong slots reject chips that bounce back and clutter the bench
